definitions.explanation: The thin, small bones in fish (and in some meat) that are easy to miss when eating and can catch in the throat.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小骨|こぼね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This fish has a lot of small bones.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小骨|こぼね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧あげた。
examples.english: I took out the small bones for my child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦{食|た}べたら→食べる：00396_taberu⟧、{小骨|こぼね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧のど⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刺|さ}さって→刺さる：02110_sasaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I ate too fast, and a small bone got stuck in my throat.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small) and ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧ (bone), with rendaku: ほね → ぼね. Fish such as mackerel pike (⟦{秋刀魚|さんま}→秋刀魚：13756_sanma⟧), sardines and carp are known for their small bones.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小骨|こぼね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to have many small bones
- {小骨|こぼね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to remove the small bones
- {小骨|こぼね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧のど⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刺|さ}さる→刺さる：02110_sasaru⟧: a small bone gets stuck in one's throat
- {小骨|こぼね}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: (soft enough) to eat even the small bones

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧: bone — the general word; a fish bone in the throat is also simply ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧
